title: MasterWorld
tagline: A classic fantasy roleplaying game in the browser, with a virtual game master that builds the world as you play.
description:
MasterWorld is a classic fantasy roleplaying game that runs in the browser on three.js. There is no pre-authored campaign: a virtual game master watches what you do and builds the world as it is needed, so the places you visit exist because you went looking for them.

Walk a living world of towns, hamlets and wild country, talk to the people you meet, and play a session that shapes itself around your choices. A desktop browser with WebGL 2 or WebGPU is all it needs.
highlights: A virtual game master builds the world as play demands it
Towns, hamlets and villages planned at the scale of their population
Runs entirely in the browser on three.js — no install
